verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer's docs say it can create media, including images, from delegated tasks. They also say it can process image files, which suggests some image manipulation. Neither claim explicitly describes prompt-driven image generation or editing, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language image generation, documented image-editing workflows (e.g., modifying an existing image by prompt), and independent or hands-on evidence of output quality.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can generate and edit images from natural-language prompts
